name: @civitai/blocks-react
description: React hooks and iframe transport for Civitai Apps. Pairs with @civitai/app-sdk/blocks.
comment-peerDependencies: The @civitai/app-sdk floor is DERIVED, not chosen: it is the lowest published
version that exports every symbol this package imports from the peer.
🔴 RAISED 0.47.0 -> 0.49.0 (THE FOURTH TIME: #309, #317, #344, then this) when
`internal/mockHost.ts` began importing four NEW peer VALUE symbols --
`APP_STORAGE_ERROR_VALUE_TOO_LARGE`, `APP_STORAGE_ERROR_USER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`,
`APP_STORAGE_ERROR_USER_ROW_LIMIT` and `APP_STORAGE_ERROR_REQUEST_FAILED`, the
host's own storage-rejection messages, which it now emits instead of the invented
`PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` / `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` (#343). All four ship for the first
time in the app-sdk minor released alongside this change.
HOW 0.49.0 WAS DERIVED (computed, not predicted from release ordering) -- the same
three steps as 0.47.0 below, RE-RUN after this branch was rebased onto 8971ba3
(`chore(release): version packages (#365)`), because a rebase invalidates the base:
- in-tree `packages/civitai-app-sdk/package.json` is 0.48.0, and 0.48.0 is also
`npm view @civitai/app-sdk version` -- nothing is mid-flight. #365 bumped only
@civitai/blocks-react (0.55.0 -> 0.55.1) and @civitai/components; app-sdk did
not move.
- `git ls-tree -r origin/main .changeset/` shows main carries NO pending
changesets at all -- #365 consumed every one -- so this branch's changeset is
the only input to the next release plan.
- `pnpm exec changeset status --verbose` on this branch prints
`@civitai/app-sdk 0.49.0` (and `@civitai/blocks-react 0.56.0`).
There is no published tarball to probe for these four: they do not exist on npm
yet. That is the same position #344 was in, and the same derivation is used.
🔴 SO 0.49.0 IS A PREDICTION, AND IT IS PINNED AS ONE. The four symbols are
declared in `PEER_SYMBOLS_PREDICTED_BY_THIS_BRANCH` in
`tests/guards/blocks-react-peer-floor.test.mjs`; its `PREDICTED ENTRY` test
re-derives the version from the tree on every run and requires BOTH that the
ledger entries name it and that this floor equals it exactly. If another app-sdk
minor publishes first, the computed version becomes 0.50.0 and that test goes RED
-- where every other assertion in the file stays green on the stale number, which
is #344's shape for a fourth time. Delete the four from that list and re-measure
against the real tarball once this release has actually published.
⚠️ `changeset status` now logs `Package "@civitai/blocks-react" must depend on the
current version of "@civitai/app-sdk": "0.48.0" vs ">=0.49.0 <1.0.0"`. That is
EXPECTED and not a failure (rc=0, and the release plan still prints): the floor
names the version this PR's own changeset publishes, which by construction does not
exist yet. #344 raised the floor to 0.47.0 from an in-tree 0.46.0 in exactly the
same way, logged the same line, and published. No CI job runs `changeset status`
-- tracked as #367, and the guard above is the tree-local mitigation, not a fix.
🔴 RAISED 0.45.0 -> 0.47.0 (THE THIRD TIME THIS CLASS HAS BITTEN: #309, then
#317 caught it in review, then this) when `internal/mockHost.ts` began importing
three NEW peer VALUE symbols -- `APP_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES`, `APP_STORAGE_MAX_ROWS`
and `APP_STORAGE_MAX_VALUE_BYTES`, the App Storage ceilings, which it assigns to
its mock storage defaults. All three ship for the first time in the app-sdk minor
released alongside this change.
HOW 0.47.0 WAS DERIVED (computed, not predicted from release ordering):
- in-tree `packages/civitai-app-sdk/package.json` is 0.46.0, and 0.46.0 is also
`npm view @civitai/app-sdk version` -- the tree is at the last published
version, so nothing is mid-flight.
- the pending changeset set is exactly ONE file, `.changeset/
app-storage-real-ceilings-2026-09-19.md`, declaring `@civitai/app-sdk: minor`;
`git ls-tree -r origin/main .changeset/` shows main carries no others.
- `pnpm exec changeset status --verbose` on this branch prints
`@civitai/app-sdk 0.47.0` (and `@civitai/blocks-react 0.54.0`). That is the
tool that will actually run, answering with the number it will actually write.
MEASURED, both directions, against the REAL tarballs (not the workspace copy):
- published 0.46.0 -- which the OLD `>=0.45.0` range SATISFIED, installing with
no peer warning at all -- does not export any of the three. `node -e` on a
scratch `npm i @civitai/app-sdk@0.46.0`:
SyntaxError: The requested module '@civitai/app-sdk/blocks'
does not provide an export named 'APP_STORAGE_MAX_BYTES'
Controls were run BOTH ways before believing that zero: an impossible symbol
reported absent (the probe can go red) and `BrowsingLevel`/`SFW_LEVELS`
resolved (the probe can see a symbol that IS there).
- blast radius is the `./testing` subpath ONLY, and that is measured too, by
`pnpm pack`ing this package and importing both entries against 0.46.0:
`@civitai/blocks-react` resolved 61 exports fine; `@civitai/blocks-react/
testing` threw the SyntaxError above out of `dist/internal/mockHost.js`.
`src/testing.tsx` reaches `mockHost`, `src/index.ts` does not -- so the block
boots and every dev harness and downstream test suite dies instead.
- with the floor at 0.47.0, that same install is refused: npm reports
ERESOLVE against `@civitai/app-sdk@0.46.0`.
⚠️ THE RESIDUAL RISK IS RELEASE ORDERING, AND IT IS NOT REMOVABLE FROM HERE.
0.47.0 is the version THIS changeset publishes from THIS base. If another app-sdk
minor merges and publishes before this PR does, 0.47.0 ships WITHOUT the
constants, this changeset publishes 0.48.0, and this range admits a broken
version -- #309's shape exactly. So: RE-RUN `changeset status --verbose` after any
rebase onto a moved main, and re-read this range. The number here is a
measurement of a base, and a rebase invalidates the base.
🔴 `changeset version` WILL NOT FIX A STALE FLOOR -- IT IS NOT A BACKSTOP.
`.changeset/config.json` sets `onlyUpdatePeerDependentsWhenOutOfRange: true`, so a
peer range is rewritten ONLY when the computed version falls OUT of it. A floor
that is too LOW is, by construction, still satisfied -- so it is left exactly as
it is and ships stale. (The flag does bite in the other direction, which an
earlier note recorded: run before a rebase, when the computed version is BELOW the
declared floor, it rewrites the range DOWNWARD and drops the upper bound. Both
readings say the same thing -- never let this number be the flag's problem.)
🔴 A PEER RANGE IS METADATA AND NOTHING CHECKS IT AGAINST THE CODE. 0.49.0-0.51.0
declared >=0.29.0 while importing `effectiveBrowsingCeiling` (app-sdk 0.39.0) and
the create-post types (0.40.0). The range was SATISFIED, so no install warned;
the failure landed at module evaluation in a consumer's tests, where 27 of 43
test files collected ZERO tests -- 292 tests stopped running and the summary line
reported no failures. See #309. NO BUILD OR TYPECHECK CAN CATCH THIS:
`pnpm.overrides` maps the peer to the workspace copy, so every in-repo typecheck,
test and build resolves the symbol from `packages/civitai-app-sdk` and is
structurally blind to whatever this range says.
🔴 SINCE #344 ONE GATE DOES SEE PART OF IT: `tests/guards/
blocks-react-peer-floor.test.mjs` fails when this range admits an app-sdk version
measured NOT to export the App Storage constants, and when the derivation below
stops being recorded here. Read its KNOWN LIMITS before relying on it -- CI checks
out at `fetch-depth: 1` and the guard job has no registry access, so it is
offline and tree-local: it re-asserts a measurement taken by hand, it does not
take one. The steps below are still the only way to MAKE the measurement.
🔴 AND #309'S OWN SUGGESTED FLOOR (>=0.39.0) WAS WRONG. `effectiveBrowsingCeiling`
arrives in 0.39.0, but `BlockCreatePostRequest`, `BlockCreatePostResult`,
`BlockCreatePostHostError` and `BlockPostSource` arrive in 0.40.0, and there is no
0.39.x patch between them. Landing the issue's number would have closed it and
stayed broken. Do not take a floor from a ticket.
TO RE-DERIVE IT (do this when this package starts importing a new peer symbol):
1. collect the symbols -- every named `import`/`export … from '@civitai/app-sdk*'`
clause in src/, plus bare and star forms, which name a SUBPATH and no symbols
but still have to resolve. Measured at #344: 64 distinct symbols over 2
subpaths ('/blocks' and '/safe-storage'), counting unique names across every
named import clause in src/**/*.ts{,x}. An earlier derivation recorded 62;
re-count rather than trusting either figure.
2. in a scratch dir OUTSIDE this workspace (pnpm would resolve the peer to the
workspace copy and measure nothing), `npm i @civitai/app-sdk@<version>` and
typecheck a file importing all of them -- each in the POSITION it is imported
in here, since a type-only export satisfies a plain value import and that is
the #309 failure mode itself.
3. the floor is the lowest version with zero missing. Confirm the version BELOW
it is missing something, or the floor is higher than it needs to be.
4. include a symbol you know does not exist, and check it reports. A run that
finds nothing is indistinguishable from one wired to nothing.
A 584-line script that automated this was written and then cut: three audit rounds
found defects in the SCRIPT while the floor value it derived never changed, and
nothing in the repo ran it. The derivation is rare and the number is recorded here;
the tool was the expensive half.
